value.rationale: Abelian complexity is a natural complete factor-count invariant. The finding classifies it at every length for a genuine infinite family of minimal aperiodic binary substitutions in exact O(log n) operations, determines an unbounded logarithmic ladder and an exact one-count balance at all substitution scales. It is not an isolated finite table or a relabeling of the already-known radix-two word.
